title: The Polite Liar: Epistemic Pathology in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis and illustrative diagnostic cases (e.g., real-time data queries, hallucinated coding libraries) showing how RLHF penalizes epistemic restraint, alongside a proposed Confidence-Evidence Ratio (Φ) metric to evaluate assertoric force versus evidential warrant.
Conceptual mapping of RLHF optimization to Gricean conversational maxims, demonstrating how human preference data rewards a readable, sincere tone and conceals uncertainty.
Conceptual analysis of the human preference collection process, showing how raters penalize concise or hesitant responses, thereby incentivizing over-assertion beyond a model's justified knowledge.
